headline: Ghana's GCB Bank Reports 42.6% Increase in Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit
summary: GCB Bank PLC posted a profit before tax of GH¢2.87 billion for the nine months to September 2026. Non-performing loans fell to 4.8% as overall loan volumes grew 47.7%.
why: GCB Bank is one of Ghana's largest commercial banking institutions.

impacts.name: GCB Bank
impacts.why: Rising profitability and lower non-performing loan ratios strengthen GCB Bank's capital base.
